evidence.reason: The current code still uses truthiness (`x or default`) to select optional injected ports. A supplied fake `SystemdPort` can be falsey (for example via `__len__` returning 0 pending jobs), so `production_adapter` replaces it with the real `SubprocessSystemd` and can later reach the real user manager. The same pattern applies to the other optional ports. Using `is None` preserves any injected object while retaining defaults only when the argument was not supplied; this is a routine correctness fix, not a new requirement.
